name: Status Bar & Desktop Panels
shortDesc: Displays workspaces, clocks, hardware gauges, audio volume, and network status.
detailedDesc: Requests top-layer surface space from the compositor via wlr-layer-shell.

phase.title: Desktop Shell & Core Plumbings
phase.description: Status bars, launchers, notification systems, on-screen displays, and wallpaper managers.

packages.name: Waybar (Recommended)
packages.description: The de-facto standard customizable status bar for wlroots and Hyprland compositors with JSON configuration and CSS styling.
cons: Polling modules require shell scripts for complex interactive dials

packages.name: Quickshell
packages.description: Next-generation programmable desktop shell framework powered by QtQuick, QML, and JavaScript. Build full reactive HUDs and visual instruments.
pros: Complete reactive UI programming with QML & JS
cons: Requires QML knowledge for deep custom development

packages.name: Eww (ElKowar's Wacky Widgets)
packages.description: Standalone widget system written in Rust using Yuck syntax and SCSS styling.
cons: Custom Yuck configuration syntax has a steep learning curve

packages.name: Yambar
packages.description: Modular, ultra-minimal status panel for X11 and Wayland with zero toolkit bloat.
cons: Fewer pre-made graphical widgets compared to Waybar
